notes: «جميعا عن حاتم» joins the two co-transmitters into one level. The dashed «قال أبو بكر حدثنا حاتم بن إسماعيل المدني» is the same man written again, so the fuller form stands once (rule 7).

«عن أبيه» is a bare relation (rule 7). Jabir is the last link: his account of the Prophet's Hajj is the report. «فقلت أنا محمد بن علي بن حسين» is the speaker introducing himself inside the story; no link is drawn from it (rule 9).
